description: Write (or overwrite) one note in the office memory so the next bot, or you in your next session, finds it: working context only (what a customer prefers, where the export lives, what you tried and what failed). key 1–64 characters (lower-case letters, digits, _ . -), text 1–2000 characters, plain. Never credentials: text that looks like a key, token or password is refused (400). 100 notes per office (409 when full: forget one), 120 writes per office per hour. The note records you as its writer. Same as PUT /v1/in/memory/:key. Example: {"key":"customer.acme.preferences","text":"Acme wants invoices as PDF, cc their AP mailbox"}.

agent_id.description: Only on a link that is not bound to one bot: which bot is writing.

key.description: The note's key; the same key overwrites.

text.description: The note, plain text. No credentials, no customer personal data.

name: remember
title: Remember a note
